source: Uppsala Conflict Data Program (UCDP) public downloads

method.actor_filter: Government of Israel must be coded as a UCDP conflict actor.
method.attack_filter: Conservative textual classification requiring UCDP metadata to explicitly describe Israeli/IDF forces carrying out an attack/strike/shelling/bombardment/raid/shooting or related military attack.
method.warning: UCDP does not provide a universal perpetrator/weapon variable. This is a classified subset of UCDP events, not a complete census of every Israeli attack.

events.location: Ceasefire line with Israel, in the southern Governorate of Quneitra
